text.text_excerpt: We took the Saint Louis Cemetery #1 tour during the day with Angela and she was wonderful. A lot of knowledge and personality. We really enjoyed ourselves so much that we booked another tour for the following night for the Ghost tour. We had Hope for that tour and she was also very knowledgeable and fun! There are Groupons/Living Social deals out there for tours so make sure to jump on those if you're on a budget. Would recommend these tours to anyone traveling to New Orleans that are looking for some cool info on the city. You can bring beer with you on the tour too!

Great tour guides!! Followed my Yelpers and bought tickets for 2 tours through the Phantoms. Cemetery Tour We started our day with our tour after getting some beignets. We did the 1pm with Robert. We met at the VooDoo Lounge around 12:30. When doing the tours they do a special for 2 for 1 hurricanes. We couldn't resist. At 1 they requested us to go outside to meet with our tour guides. Robert introduced himself and explained the rules of the tour and the cemetery. St. Louis #1 is where we were going. What i likes about the tour was he went over the history. Went on another tour with french quarter phantoms. We went on the cemetery tour with Luke this time. This is really a great tour and I love that the tour guide Luke was not only knowledgeable about the city and the cemetery but also was genuinely interested in respecting and preserving the tombs in the cemetery. He told us how destructive touching, leaning against, or standing on the tombs was and made sure everyone in his group was respectful of that. He was also respectful of the history of people of color in New Orleans and did not erase or romanticize the hardships and atrocities endured here which is really important to me.
